history.summary: ISKCON (International Society for Krishna Consciousness) temple at ISKCON Road, English Bazar, Malda. Founded globally in 1966 by A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada; the founding date of the Malda centre is not found in any consulted source (flag: verify). Festivals listed are standard ISKCON observances; confirm the local calendar (verify).

name: ISKCON Malda
town_description: Malda (English Bazar) is the district headquarters of Malda district in northern West Bengal, a historic city on the Mahananda river near the ruins of Gaur.

travel.airport: Bagdogra Airport (~250 km) or Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport, Kolkata (~340 km)
travel.road: ISKCON Road, English Bazar, Malda 732101; well connected by NH-12 (old NH-34)

visitor_information.opening_hours: Sun 4:30 AM-9:00 PM; Mon-Sat 7:00 AM-9:00 PM per online listing (verify)
